data.label: Deleting a slice requires confirmation, removes all of that slice's nodes and edges (including edges crossing into other slices), never touches other slices' own nodes/edges, and does not cascade-delete the slice's Layer 2 Example Map data in localStorage
Deleting a slice with only internal edges

scenario.given: a slice with 2 nodes and 1 edge connecting them, both entirely within that slice
scenario.when: the user confirms deleting the slice
scenario.then: both nodes and the edge are removed, and no other slice's nodes or edges anywhere on the board are affected

data.label: Deleting a slice with a cross-slice edge

scenario.given: a slice whose Outcome node has an edge to a different slice's Actor node (a cross-slice trigger edge)
scenario.then: the cross-slice edge is removed since one of its endpoints no longer exists, but the second slice's own nodes and any edges entirely within it remain untouched

data.label: Cancelling the confirmation leaves everything untouched

scenario.given: the user clicks Delete Slice on a slice
scenario.then: no nodes, edges, or other state changes at all

data.label: Deleting the selected node's slice clears selection

scenario.given: a node in the slice being deleted is currently selected and shown in the Scenario panel
scenario.then: the selection is cleared so the panel does not keep showing a now-deleted node's stale data

data.label: Example Map data is not cascade-deleted

scenario.given: a slice has existing Rule/Example/Question cards saved in localStorage
scenario.when: the slice is deleted from the canvas
scenario.then: the localStorage Example Map data for that slice id is left untouched — orphaned, and recoverable if a slice with the same id is ever recreated

data.label: If any Cross-Cutting Concern's appliesTo list references the slice being deleted, the user is warned before the deletion proceeds, not blocked
Deleting a slice referenced by a Concern shows a warning

scenario.given: a Cross-Cutting Concern's appliesTo list includes the slice being deleted
scenario.then: the confirmation dialog names the referencing concern(s) and still allows the user to proceed or cancel

data.label: Deleting a slice with no Concern references shows the plain confirmation

scenario.given: no Cross-Cutting Concern references the slice being deleted
scenario.then: the plain confirmation dialog appears with no warning text
